nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/laptop_memory/MEMORY.md - the laptop memory index as it stood 2026-08-03: the auto-loading list of every memory entry with its one-line summary, which is the part agents actually skim

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. The index groups its entries as results (held-out 100 generalization, corroboration probe verdict), working mode (orchestrator mode, background workers, agent roster, react to anger, terminology canon, user concepts are canon), conduct (trust revoked, infer context like a human, visible progress, commit means push, commit style, source of truth, grounding), environment (v3 state docs location, laptop env limits, headless claude models), tooling (reusable tools, never relaunch expensive runs, judge-run cost math) and project findings (gold-100 results and judge, adversarial panel verdicts, ordering diagnosis, combine sweep and hybrid results, machinery fix and toggles, curve-cut experiment, benchmark validity caveats, v1 lineage and cost delta, final audit panel, audit panel 2026-07-28). CANON_AUDIT.md adjudicates this surface at 18 claims: 12 GROUNDED, 1 AGENT-ORIGIN, 2 CONTRADICTS-USER, 3 STALE
